summary: Confirmed the profile-create completion replaces another teacher's current public-profile projection with the signed-in teacher's own profile, and the edit action then succeeds on that mismatched route.

scope.provider_boundary: volatile in-memory synthetic fixture only; no backend/network call and no real teacher data
scope.browser_visual_qa: not performed; controller state/projection and dispatch authority were inspected

execution.result: completed all probe assertions and controls
setup_operations: Initialize controller on /register; choose Demo Washington / Demo King / Demo District / Demo Academy.
Register Cycle Five Synthetic using volatile-only credentials and the synthetic example.invalid alias.
Invoke Demo.simulateApproval, then Session.login, then initialize the own-profile route.
interleaving: Hold the fixture provider's TeacherProfile.createProfile operation behind a promise gate.
While it is pending, navigate to /public-profile/demo-avery; TeacherProfile.openPublicProfile completes and projects seed teacher demo-seed-avery.
Resolve the held create operation and inspect route/profile projection plus public:edit-profile dispatch.

provider_state_vs_displayed_route.before_create_resolution: Current route /public-profile/demo-avery displayed profile demo-avery, teacher demo-seed-avery, name Demo Avery.
provider_state_vs_displayed_route.after_create_resolution: Provider snapshot correctly records authenticated teacher demo-teacher-1 and own profile profile-demo-teacher-1, but the unchanged route /public-profile/demo-avery displays profile-demo-teacher-1 / Cycle Five Own Profile.
provider_state_vs_displayed_route.edit_authority: public:edit-profile returns ok:true on /public-profile/demo-avery because the overwritten projection's teacherId matches the signed-in teacher.

controls.own_profile_route: Navigating to /public-profile/profile-demo-teacher-1 displays the created profile and edit succeeds as expected.
controls.captured_read_only_reference: Navigating to /public-profile/reference-sarah displays readOnly:true and edit is denied with read_only_reference.

finding.minimal_root_cause: service() unconditionally calls syncRuntime() after the delayed provider operation; syncRuntime() unconditionally replaces journey.profile with raw.ownProfile when present. The public:profile-create success branch then applies the new own-profile overlay without checking whether routeEpoch/current profile route still belongs to that operation.
finding.bounded_correction_candidate: Preserve the active public-profile projection during runtime sync when the current route profileId is not the newly-created own profile ID; only project the own profile on the own-profile route (or when there is no profileId). Add a promise-controlled regression asserting route/profile coherence and that edit authority cannot switch to the signed-in teacher on another teacher's route. Preserve the captured read-only reference guard and the own-profile positive control.
finding.evidence_limit: This is controller/service-fixture evidence, not screenshot/browser QA or production/backend behavior.

evidence.post_probe_repo_status: No tracked source changes; the status showed a concurrent untracked PageRouter/work/hh-continuous-improvement/cycle-05/ directory that was root-owned and not touched by H1.
